answer.title: Automate Supplier Bill Entry from Invoices
answer.trigger: An email is received with a subject line indicating a new supplier invoice and payment due date.
steps: Receive the supplier invoice email from DrainPro.
Extract the invoice reference number, amount, and payment due date.
Draft a new supplier bill in the accounts system with the extracted details.
Flag the draft bill for human review before final entry.
answer.ai_help: Extracting the reference number, due date, and amount from the incoming invoice email.
answer.human_approval: Emma reviews and approves the draft supplier bill in the accounts system before it is saved.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect bill details entered into accounts could lead to overpayment or accounting errors.
